ideas.pitch: A pedestrian routing app that navigates students through campus buildings, tunnels, and elevators to completely avoid Pittsburgh winter weather.
ideas.title: CMU Campus Route Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves by targeting the exact daily pain point of navigating cold, hilly CMU campus infrastructure during winter.

ideas.pitch: An automated processing pipeline that turns raw recorded audio from large CS lectures into structured flashcards and dependency graphs.
ideas.title: LectureLogic AI Study Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets student life directly, meaning every organizer and student judge immediately understands and values the utility.

ideas.pitch: A predictive forecasting tool using historical swipe data and computer vision streams to predict wait times across all campus dining locations.
ideas.title: Tartan Dining Hall Crowd Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses clear data science modeling similar to winning forecasting hacks, providing instant quantifiable utility for hungry students.

ideas.pitch: A transparent course registration analytics platform that pulls historical Andrew tool data to model true weekly student workloads.
ideas.title: CourseMatch Grade & Workload Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a universal frustration among CMU students trying to balance heavy technical course loads.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized ride-sharing and trip-coordination tool specifically optimized for CMU students traveling to grocery stores and the airport.
ideas.title: Pittsburgh Transit Micro-Coordination Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a clear social impact and community benefit with a tight, localized scope tailored to Pittsburgh transport challenges.
